prompt:
The woman of the first and second reference pictures, with exactly her face, her grey-blue eyes, her
freckles and her dark blonde hair pulled back, sits on the grey chair on the far side of the light
wooden table of the seminar room of the third reference picture, facing the camera across the table,
in the soft daylight from the window on the right. Use the first two pictures for her face and hair
only. She wears a plain grey-blue wool cardigan, open, over a plain white round-necked blouse.

She is seen from the waist up, in the middle of a vertical frame. The table top crosses the bottom of
the picture just below her forearms, which rest on it; her hands lie loosely one over the other on the
bare wood, empty. The top of her head sits a hand's width under the top edge, so that her face is one
of the largest things in the picture. She looks straight into the lens with a calm, friendly, attentive
expression, a slight closed-lip smile, as an examiner who is about to begin. Behind her, the off-white
wall, and on the right the window with its white frame and the pale leaves outside.

The textures of real wool, cotton, wood, skin and painted plaster, as a visitor would take it with a
good phone camera.
